company.name: Kid ASA
company.summary: Kid ASA, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home textile retailer in Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Estonia. The company designs, sources, markets, and sells a range of home and interior products, including textiles, curtains, bed linens, home accessories, decorations, furniture, and other interior products through retail stores and online platforms. It offers products for bedroom, bathroom, easter, beds, outdoor spaces, table settings, kitchenware, office accessories, children room, loungewear and accessories, and sun protection, as well as lamps, pillows and blankets, and carpets. The company offers its products under the Kid Interior and Hemtex brands. The company was formerly known as Nordisk Tekstil Holding AS and changed its name to Kid ASA. Kid ASA was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Gullaug, Norway.

narrative.company_headline: 7.5% revenue CAGR, 12.3% EBITDA margin and 1.5x net debt/EBITDA — market cap NOK 4.8bn
highlights: **Consistent growth:** revenue compounded at 7.5% p.a. over 2022–2025, reaching NOK 3,945m
**Margin profile:** pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA margin of 12.3% in 2025A (down from 13.1% in 2022A), EBIT margin 8.7%
**Weak cash conversion:** unlevered FCF of NOK 13m in 2025A, 3% of EBITDA (average 44% over 2022–2025), ROIC 13%
**Balance sheet:** net debt of NOK 722m equals 1.5x EBITDA, a conservative leverage level

financial_commentary: **Kid grew revenue by 4.2% in 2025A** to NOK 3,945m, with pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA of NOK 485m (12.3% margin)
**We forecast 2026E revenue of NOK 4,230m (+7.2%)**, anchored on consensus (4 analysts), fading to 2.0% terminal growth by 2031E
**EBITDA margin path:** 12.8% in 2026E to 15.3% in 2031E; D&A 3.4% and capex 5.6% normalising to 3.6% of revenue; tax rate 22%
**Unlevered FCF** rises from NOK 207m to NOK 467m over the forecast period (9.1% FCF margin in 2031E)
**Valuation vs peers:** Kid trades at 11.4x LTM EV/EBITDA versus a peer median of 9.8x (+17%) and 21.1x P/E versus 20.2x
**Street view:** consensus target of NOK 139.50 across 4 analysts (+17% vs current price)
narrative.valuation_subtitle: We recommend a BUY. Our 12-month target price of NOK 130.00 implies +9% upside and a +16% total return including dividend; 10.3x 2026E EV/EBITDA.
narrative.valuation_headline: DCF fair value NOK 126.74, peer multiples NOK 99.28, scenario-weighted NOK 130.92 versus a share price of NOK 118.80 — BUY
market_implied: **Market-implied WACC 8.9%**, in line with our 8.6%: the price discounts our cash flows at 35bp more than we do
**Market-implied margin:** at our WACC the price is consistent with a 2031E EBITDA margin of 14.8% versus 15.3% in our base case

**Cross-check – medium agreement:** the DCF is 28% above the peer-multiple value (NOK 99.28) and our target is 7% below the consensus of 4 analysts (NOK 139.50); review the growth, margin and WACC assumptions before relying on the target
scenario_commentary: **Bear (25%):** Growth 2pp lower, margin 1.5pp lower, WACC +50bp; revenue CAGR 2.5%, 2031E margin 13.8%, WACC 9.1% gives NOK 83.96 (-29% vs price)
**Base (50%):** Base-case drivers; revenue CAGR 4.5%, 2031E margin 15.3%, WACC 8.6% gives NOK 126.74 (+7% vs price)
**Bull (25%):** Growth 2pp higher, margin 1.5pp higher, WACC -50bp; revenue CAGR 6.5%, 2031E margin 16.8%, WACC 8.1% gives NOK 186.23 (+57% vs price)
thesis: **DCF value of NOK 126.74 per share** (WACC 8.6%, terminal growth 2.0%); terminal value is 75% of EV, implying 9.1x exit EV/EBITDA
**Peer multiples imply NOK 99.28** per share (median of EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT and P/E-based values)
**Scenarios:** bear NOK 84 / base NOK 127 / bull NOK 186; probability-weighted NOK 130.92
**12-month target price NOK 130.00:** fair value NOK 126.74 rolled forward at the 8.8% cost of equity less NOK 7.50 dividend; expected total return +16%, rating BUY
multiples_commentary: **Trading at a premium:** 11.4x EV/EBITDA vs 9.8x peer median (17% premium)
**Earnings multiple:** 21.1x trailing P/E vs 20.2x for peers (+4%)
**Versus own history:** 11.4x trailing EV/EBITDA is above the 3.5-year median of 9.5x (83% of weeks were cheaper)
**EV/EBITDA-implied value:** NOK 99.28 at the peer median of 9.8x (range 83–121 across the 25th–75th percentile)
risks: **Valuation sensitivity:** a 50bp higher WACC lowers the DCF value to NOK 115.76; 25bp lower terminal growth to NOK 122.53
**Execution:** the case assumes 7.2% growth in 2026E and margins of 15.3% by 2031E; a return to the 2022–2025 average margin of 14.8% would cut fair value
**Macro:** consumer spending, interest rates and FX can move revenue and the discount rate simultaneously
